hero_subhead: From urgent blown fuses to full house rewires, we're here when you need us—same-day repairs available across Leicester.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped switches, dead circuits—we diagnose and fix faults fast, usually the same day. No job too small.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Ageing electrics? We replace outdated wiring with modern, safe systems that meet current building regs and come with a 10-year guarantee.

services.title: Fusebox Upgrades
services.desc: Switch from old rewireable fuses to a modern consumer unit. Improves safety, adds circuits, and future-proofs your home.

services.title: Landlord & Periodic Testing
services.desc: EICR electrical safety certificates for lettings, property sales, and insurance. We arrange inspections at a time that suits you.

services.title: Kitchen & Bathroom Electrics

services.title: Commercial Electrical Work
services.desc: Office rewires, data circuits, emergency lighting, and maintenance contracts. We keep Leicester businesses lit and compliant.

about_pullquote: We answer the phone because we know how stressful a dead socket can be.
about_para_1: Park-Elec was founded on a simple principle: get to you fast, sort it properly, and charge fair money. For over 15 years, we've been the electrician Leicester homeowners and businesses call when things go wrong—and when they're planning something new. We've rewired thousands of homes, upgraded countless fusebox installations, and built a reputation for turning up on time and finishing what we start.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is responsiveness. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth—people remember an electrician who shows up when promised and explains what's happened before hitting them with the bill. We're NICEIC approved, we carry spare parts on the van, and our team is properly trained and insured. When you call Park-Elec, you get straightforward electrical advice and reliable work, not pressure to buy things you don't need.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Park-Elec

reviews.text: Blown my fusebox on a Saturday night and I was in a right panic. Called Park-Elec and they were here within the hour. Professional, quick, and explained exactly what had happened and why. Brilliant service. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had my entire house rewired by these lads. Took a week, hardly any mess, and they made sure everything was tested and certified before they left. Cost less than two other quotes I got and they actually finished on time. Top-quality work.
reviews.author: Rebecca M.

reviews.text: Friendly, punctual, and honest. I rang them because I wasn't sure if I needed new kitchen electrics or just a few extra sockets. They came out, gave me sensible advice, and didn't try to oversell me. Fair price too. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael K.
